mode: Final measured timeline; mocked media events only

tests.name: Every work stop pauses before the next slide and Continue reaches the next chapter
Delayed playback cannot skip two activity boundaries
Frame and timer event paths preserve the pause guard
Intentional chapter selection bypasses skipped work but keeps playback paused
Manual seeking and replaying an earlier exercise rearm its pause
Disabling pauses allows ordinary playback and reenabling restores later stops
Wide captions are native; narrow captions remain timed below the image
Delayed caption loading and failures retain readable fallback instructions
Optional review labels and transcript contain no new attendance request

scope: No browser, decoded-video, audio or visual QA is claimed.
